description: A React component for an autocomplete input used to link items via tags, notes, or files. It manages input state, dropdown visibility, focus handling, and search results, integrating with application and linking controllers.

methods.name: showDropdown
methods.description: Calculates and sets the maximum height for the dropdown and makes it visible.

methods.name: onSearchQueryChange
methods.description: Updates search query state based on user input.

methods.name: onFormSubmit
methods.description: Handles form submission, creating a new tag if the search query is not empty.

methods.name: handleFocus
methods.description: Focuses the input element and shows the dropdown menu.

methods.name: onBlur
methods.description: Handles blur events to potentially close the dropdown.

methods.name: onKeyDown
methods.description: Handles keyboard navigation within the input, including focusing the results list.

methods.name: useEffect hook
methods.description: Focuses the input when its focusedId matches.
